brief.text: The Idea detail page of It's a Date per spec 8.4 and 8.6 for 'Golden-hour viewpoint drive': photo with save heart and count, title, tags, meta, rating summary, description, 'Your rating' input, and a compact places card ('Find places near me'); results (list, static OSM map, 3/5/10 km) and other states on a States board behind a 'Show design states' toggle.
assumptions: Logged in as Maya Chen on the main view, who has saved this idea and rated it 4; logged-out variant on the States board
Places start collapsed (owner round 1): compact card with the one coral fill; 'Places found' is a States board frame
States board is design-only, in a closed details toggle under the page
The map is a static drawn panel with OSM attribution, no real tiles (Leaflet comes in Phase 6)
Idea values follow content.md (idea 5: $ · Half day, 4.7 from 89 ratings, Sam Okafor)

tasks.name: Find an idea and the places near me
Check on an idea I shared

findings.fix: Make .map-pin.is-active a dark ring (0 0 0 2px var(--surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--fg)) so coral-ink means only "you", and remove is-active from row 1 and pin 1 in the static frame so nothing is lit until a tap or focus.
findings.where: 6 · Places found, map and list (phone and desktop)
findings.problem: The selected pin 1 has the same coral-ink ring as the "You are here" dot (.map-pin.is-active and .you-dot both use --accent-ink), and on phone the two sit side by side; row 1 is also shown lit by default, which on a phone (no hover) reads as a selection.

findings.fix: Use the same heading in both: "Viewpoints near you" at the same size (xl 24px), so expanding changes only the content below it.
findings.where: Compact places card (desktop 1/9, phone 2/9) vs 6 · Places found heading
findings.problem: The compact card says "Viewpoints near you" in plain type at about 20px, but the results it opens into say "Viewpoints near you" at about 30px, so the heading jumps in size and style when the card expands.

findings.fix: On phone, while the list is collapsed, fade pins 6 and 7 to about 40% opacity, and bring them back at full strength when "Show all 7" expands the list.
findings.problem: The map shows all 7 pins while the list shows only the nearest 5, so pins 6 and 7 have no row until "Show all 7".
